noisy-accented.transcript: Good morning, this is pre-irrogative and calling from Cuban Eats platform engineering at Zentrix by-logics. Our quarterly revenue came in at $47,300, which is about 12% below the Q3 forecast. The main issue was latency on the Postgres QL replica in Frankfurt, where page 99 responds times hit 800 milliseconds. Sayapun from the Dublin office suggested we migrate the idempotency keys to Rediscent enabled vector for the semantic search index. Before Thursday's board meeting, please confirm three things. First, the Sock 2 audit window closes on November 9. Second, the anticoagulant trial data from Massachusetts general must be dead identified under HIPAA. Third, GUY and FIFAN will present the llama fine-tuning results, including the Laura Dr. Benchmucks. If anything slips, ping me on Slack or call extension 4-4-1-9. Thanks, and let's keep the momentum going.
